build.summary:
I built structural-tips-and-tavi-course in full. The TAVI, TEER and LAAO labs now show structural tips keyed by step and procedure. A new module, src/ui/lab/structuralTips.ts, maps each step to a tip context. TAVI reports the step as the phase with procedure tavi. TEER reports transseptal as access with teer and transseptal, steer as position, grasp as deploy, then assess. LAAO reports measure and size as plan, transseptal as access with laao and transseptal, deploy, and pass as assess. The debrief reports no tip context. The module also exports `raises` for the reachability report.

TAVI now has a post-deployment course, taviCourse in src/simulation/tavi.ts. It is a labelled teaching model and every number in it is a MODEL PARAMETER. It produces MAP, HR, rhythm, ST shift and coronary filling second by second from the outcome's risks. A high coronary risk gives a pressure that stays below 65 after pacing and keeps falling, a rising ST shift in the threatened territory, and no left-coronary filling on root injection. High conduction risk with RBBB gives complete heart block. High rupture risk gives a falling pressure with both coronaries filling. Events come through the shared PatientEventAdapter, so the hypotension threshold and hold match the other labs. The course raises hypotension, st-elevation, bradycardia and av-block, and adds the complication phase while any of them is active.

scoreTaviCourse scores the response: the root-injection delay after pacing stops, the rescue delay, pacing for heart block, and a small cost for calling a rescue when nothing was wrong. scoreTavi accepts the response as an optional fourth argument. With planByLearner false the plan deductions are skipped, so the coronary risk is not penalised twice.

The new scenario 'tavi-coronary-obstruction' opens at assess with an unprotected balloon-expandable valve already released in a low, narrow left-coronary root. The assess step now shows:
- a CourseMonitor (LiveTrace ECG leads II and V5 plus the arterial line)
- a RootInjectionView schematic
- buttons for root injection, calling rescue PCI and the surgeon, and pacing through the temporary wire

Findings appear only after a root injection, and the coronary and heart-block findings were removed from the live list. TaviLab, TeerLab and LaaoLab now use useLabRun (decisions plus one logbook row) instead of recordSim. They mount LabModeBar and LabTipsPanel, register window.__lab.structural, and hide the guided aids in exams (the CT overlay and the target-zone toggle). StructuralLab resolves a launch for any of the tavi, teer or laao sims to the procedure that owns the scenario, as McsLab does. The preset file declares all 15 scenarios under the tavi sim, with starts and lesson and case links. Typecheck is clean and all six test files I ran pass (130 tests).

review.verdict:
Approve with fixes. The design is fully built and correct in substance. The new structuralTips.ts maps every TAVI, TEER and LAAO step to the right phase and procedures. taviCourse produces the obstruction, heart-block and rupture courses from the outcome's risks and raises its events through the unchanged shared PatientEventAdapter, so the 65 mmHg / 10 s rule matches the other labs. scoreTaviCourse rewards an early root injection and rescue, and planByLearner=false prevents a double penalty. The 'tavi-coronary-obstruction' scenario opens at assess. All three labs use useLabRun, LabModeBar and LabTipsPanel, register __lab.structural, and hide the guided aids in exam mode.

Checks I ran:
- `npx vitest run` on tavi.test.ts, structuralTips.test.ts and structuralTips.scenario.test.ts: 68 passed. reachability, teer and laao also pass (structural row: 55 tips, 42 satisfiable, 42 ready).
- `npx tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit`: exit 0.
- Browser, in my own tab on the running 5173 server, now closed: on the TEER transseptal step, `__lab.structural.context()` returned procedures ['teer','transseptal'] with phase access, so the needs-browser criterion is met. In the obstruction scenario at about 41 s, the events were hypotension and st-elevation, with the complication phase. The first tips were structural-tavi-hypotension-coronary and structural-tavi-pacing-wire-decision. The left coronary did not fill and MAP was about 54.

Other checks:
- The scoring defaults are unchanged: scoreTavi with three arguments gives the same result as before, and every best plan still scores 100.
- No ground truth on live screens: the RiskList shows only at the debrief, and the coronary state appears only after a root injection.
- Device names are generic and spelling is British.
- The trace callbacks allocate nothing per frame.

Files changed outside the list: src/simulation/pericardiocentesis.ts, src/ui/bedside/PericardioLab.tsx, src/ui/lab/bedsideTips.ts, src/content/lab/presets/bedside/pericardio.launch.ts, src/simulation/mcs/deviceChoice*.ts, src/ui/mcs/*, src/ui/sections/McsLab.tsx, src/ui/lab/mcsTips*.ts and src/content/lab/presets/mcs/core.launch.ts. Each is a listed file of pericardiocentesis-tips-and-pci-handover or mcs-console-split-select-and-tips, or a new test beside them (mcs.test.ts). None needs action.

Findings: one major scoring loophole (complete heart block can go unpaced without penalty by accepting early) and several minor issues.

findings.where: src/simulation/tavi.ts, scoreTaviCourse, the complete-heart-block check (`if (c.chbS !== null && endS > c.chbS + R.paceWithinS && ...)`)
findings.problem: A learner who accepts the result within a minute of block onset, without pacing, gets no deduction. chbS is pacingEndS + 8 = 13 s, so pressing 'Accept result' at any time up to 73 s leaves the patient in unpaced complete heart block at full score. TaviLab still logs the 'chb-pacing' decision as incorrect, so the score and the decision disagree.
findings.fix: Replace the condition with `const chbMissed = c.chbS !== null && endS >= c.chbS && (paced === null || paced - c.chbS > R.paceWithinS);` and push the 6-point deduction when chbMissed. Leaving with the block unpaced then counts. Add a tavi.test.ts case: tavi-conduction with the deep plan, endS = chbS + 20, no pacingS, expect the 'Complete heart block was not paced' deduction.

findings.where: src/ui/structural/TaviLab.tsx, debrief effect, the r.decide({ id: 'chb-pacing' ... }) block
findings.problem: The pacing decision is recorded whenever course.chbS is set, even if the learner ended assess before the block began. That logs 'Not paced' as an error for a block that never appeared on the monitor.
findings.fix: Guard it with `if (c.chbS !== null && endS !== null && endS >= c.chbS)`, the same rule as the scoring fix above.

findings.problem: The course is built from deployedPlan, which is fixed in finishDeployment (or by the scenario). Post-dilating at the assess step updates plan and outcome, which raises the rupture risk in the model, but the course never shows the falling-pressure rupture course. The design says the course follows the outcome's risks.
findings.fix: Either add `postDilatationS` to CourseActions and apply the rupture branch from that time when assessTavi(s, {...plan, postDilatation: true}).risks.rupture.level is high, so earlier samples stay unchanged, or state in the TaviLab header comment and the debrief note that the course reflects the valve as released, before post-dilatation.

findings.problem: The acceptance criterion says practiceIndex lists every scenario in core.launch.ts under hb-tavi-candidate, hb-tavi-workup and hb-tavi-procedure. That is literally unmet because the 4 TEER and 4 LAAO scenarios sit in the same file under sim 'tavi'. Their practice entries and launch keys are therefore filed under the TAVI sim. 'teer' and 'laao' are valid LaunchSim values (validateLaunch.ts SIMS), so the header's claim that one file must name one sim is only a file-list constraint.
findings.fix: Move the TEER entries to src/content/lab/presets/structural/teer.launch.ts (sim 'teer') and the LAAO entries to laao.launch.ts (sim 'laao'). resolveStructuralLaunch already handles all three sims. core.launch.ts then holds only the 7 TAVI scenarios and meets the criterion literally. These files are outside this package's list, so the build lead must approve the addition. Otherwise, record the deviation in the plan.

findings.problem: Five transseptal tips assigned to this package count as satisfiable from the lab's merged raises but no structural context can show them: structural-ts-two-movements, -resistant-wire-first, -aortic-puncture-hold, -vagal-st and -posterior-delayed-tamponade. They need the transseptal procedure with the position or complication phase, or with an event. The reachability report calls them 'ready', so tip-retarget-catchup may remove them from waiting.ts even though they are unreachable. structuralTips.scenario.test.ts records this, which is good.
findings.fix: Out of scope for this package. In waiting.ts, reassign these five entries' raisedBy to structural-transseptal-hands-on so they are not removed as ready. Tell the tip-retarget-catchup owner to skip them.

findings.problem: These duplicate PATIENT_EVENT_THRESHOLDS.hypotensionMapMmHg and hypotensionHoldS from src/ui/lab/patientEvents.ts as literal 65 and 10. If the shared threshold changes, the 'rescue with a stable pressure' scoring will no longer match the hypotension event the tips use.
findings.fix: Add a test in tavi.test.ts or structuralTips.test.ts: `expect(COURSE_RESPONSE.lowMapMmHg).toBe(PATIENT_EVENT_THRESHOLDS.hypotensionMapMmHg); expect(COURSE_RESPONSE.lowMapHoldS).toBe(PATIENT_EVENT_THRESHOLDS.hypotensionHoldS);`. Alternatively, give scoreTaviCourse an optional thresholds argument and pass PATIENT_EVENT_THRESHOLDS from TaviLab.

findings.problem: The atrial rate in complete heart block (80 bpm) is a bare number outside COURSE. Every other course number is in the labelled MODEL PARAMETER block.
findings.fix: Add `/** atrial rate shown in complete heart block, bpm */ chbAtrialHr: 80,` to COURSE in tavi.ts (MODEL PARAMETER) and use `60 / COURSE.chbAtrialHr` in courseEcg.

findings.where: docs/realism/facts (no entry for the post-deployment course)
findings.problem: COURSE and COURSE_RESPONSE are labelled MODEL PARAMETER only in code comments. LAB_BUILD_PLAN asks for unsourced numbers to be labelled MODEL PARAMETER in docs/realism/facts. The folder is not in this package's file list; the builder reported it.

Leave the shared LiveTrace unchanged. Widen the read-out column, for example to `grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_5.5rem]`, or drop the unit on the ECG strips if the clipping persists.

fix.notes:
I checked all nine findings against the code. Six were right and I applied them. The other three need files outside this package and are listed as rejected with what the build lead needs to do.

1. Heart-block scoring (major), in /Users/qc25212/Downloads/Misc/Games and apps/Cath Simulator/src/simulation/tavi.ts. scoreTaviCourse now uses `const chbMissed = c.chbS !== null && endS >= c.chbS && (paced === null || paced - c.chbS > R.paceWithinS);`. Leaving the assess step with the block unpaced now costs the 6 points, even within the first minute. New tavi.test.ts case on tavi-conduction with the deep plan:
   - endS = chbS + 20 with no pacing gets the deduction.
   - Pacing at chbS + 10 gets none.
   - Leaving at chbS - 1 gets none.
   - Pacing later than paceWithinS gets exactly [6].

2. Pacing decision, in /Users/qc25212/Downloads/Misc/Games and apps/Cath Simulator/src/ui/structural/TaviLab.tsx. The 'chb-pacing' decision is now recorded only when `c.chbS !== null && endS !== null && endS >= c.chbS`, the same rule as the scoring. Pacing after endS no longer counts as done.

3. Post-dilatation and rupture: I took the first option.
   - CourseActions has a new optional field, postDilatationS.
   - TaviCourse has a new field, ruptureS. It is pacingEndS when the valve was released with a high rupture risk. It is the post-dilatation time when assessTavi(s, {...plan, postDilatation: true}) puts the rupture risk at high, and null otherwise.
   - The falling-pressure branch runs from ruptureS, so samples before it are unchanged.
   - Valves released with a high rupture risk behave exactly as before.
   - TaviLab's postDilate now records postDilatationS = courseNow() when the balloon finishes, and the header comments in tavi.ts and TaviLab say so.
   - Two new tavi.test.ts cases. The first finds every scenario and plan where post-dilatation raises the rupture risk to high (at least one exists). For each it checks that earlier samples are unchanged, that the pressure later falls below 65, and that both coronaries fill when there is no obstruction. The second checks that a post-dilatation which leaves the risk below high changes nothing.

6. Shared thresholds: a new test in /Users/qc25212/Downloads/Misc/Games and apps/Cath Simulator/src/ui/lab/structuralTips.test.ts checks that COURSE_RESPONSE.lowMapMmHg and lowMapHoldS equal PATIENT_EVENT_THRESHOLDS.hypotensionMapMmHg and hypotensionHoldS. It sits there because that file already imports patientEvents, which keeps the simulation test free of ui imports.

7. Atrial rate: COURSE.chbAtrialHr = 80 is now in the MODEL PARAMETER block, and courseEcg in /Users/qc25212/Downloads/Misc/Games and apps/Cath Simulator/src/ui/structural/TaviViews.tsx uses `60 / COURSE.chbAtrialHr`.

9. Monitor labels: CourseMonitor now draws leads II and V5 as two separate LiveTrace strips (min -1.4, max 1.8, height 64), so each label sits on its own trace. The shared LiveTrace is unchanged.
   - The clipped units were not caused by the column width. LiveTrace draws the unit once at w - 40 when it draws the grid from x = 0, and the sweep then paints over it, so widening the column would not have helped.
   - The strips now pass unit="", and the read-outs carry the units instead ('bpm' under HR, 'ART mmHg' as the arterial label). The column stays at 6.5rem.
   - I did not check this in the browser. The SSR render test in structuralTips.scenario.test.ts still passes.

No files outside the package's list were edited.

checked: I opened a new tab (tab-15) at http://localhost:5173 and went to TAVI · TEER · LAAO. window.__labHooks holds 'structural' and window.__lab.structural exposes context, tips, state, events and step. I closed the tab at the end.
TAVI plan step (tavi-standard): context is {lab:'structural', phase:'plan', procedures:['tavi']}. Every tip returned is a structural-tavi-* tip.

tavi-coronary-obstruction from the scenario selector opens at assess with a balloon-expandable valve released under rapid pacing and pacingEndS 5. The CourseMonitor shows HR 180 and ART 63/36 (45) with RAPID PACING. Root injection, rescue and pacing buttons are present, and the page says 'Inject the root and image the valve to judge the result'. No findings show before an injection. Tips at that point are pacing-wire-decision and pvr-mechanism, with no hypotension tip.

I used step(40) to move to t=52 s, after pacing. The sample was MAP 54, sinus 72, ST 2.4 mm, leftFills false. context.events were ['hypotension','st-elevation'] and phases ['complication']. tips() put structural-tavi-hypotension-coronary first, then structural-tavi-pacing-wire-decision. The panel listed 'Events: hypotension, st-elevation'.

I clicked Root injection at 0:58 (54 s after pacing stopped). The schematic shows the right coronary filling and only a stub on the left. I then called rescue at 1:28 and the button became 'Rescue called 1:28'. After step(120), MAP was 73, ST 0.03 and leftFills true. I clicked Accept result: the debrief scored 100 with 'Flow in the left coronary was restored 173 s after pacing stopped', and the context became null.

I launched an exam through useUiStore.openSim('tavi',{scenario:'tavi-coronary-obstruction',mode:'exam'}). It opened at assess with the label 'Exam', no CT overlay and tips() []. I waited 185 s with step(185), then injected and called rescue. The debrief scored 85 with a -15 'Root injection 188 s after pacing stopped' deduction and 'restored late (278 s) ... ventricular function is left impaired'. Root injection within 60 s scored better than waiting 3 min, as the acceptance requires.
The logbook counter in the sidebar went from 11 to 13 after the two TAVI debriefs, so useLabRun logs one row per run.

TEER acceptance: on 'Plan the transseptal puncture', __lab.structural.context() was {phase:'access', procedures:['teer','transseptal']} (met). Tips were structural-ts-* and structural-teer-height-coaptation. In an exam launch (teer-fmr) the context is the same, tips() is [] and the 'Show target zone' toggle is hidden.

LAAO: the measure step reports phase 'plan' with ['laao']. After measuring all four angles, the transseptal step reports phase 'access' with ['laao','transseptal'] and returns ts-* and laao-puncture-from-ct tips.
Launch resolution: openSim('laao',{scenario:'tavi-low-coronary'}) opened the TAVI tab with that scenario at plan. openSim('tavi',{scenario:'laao-cactus'}) opened LAAO at measure.

For a learner-run tavi-conduction case I chose a self-expanding valve, depth 12 mm and full release, then detached. Course after 30 s: rhythm 'chb', HR 38, MAP 57, events ['av-block','bradycardia','hypotension']. Clicking 'Pace through the temporary wire' gave rhythm 'paced', HR 70, MAP 85, and the events cleared. 2 (minor), findings list in /Users/qc25212/Downloads/Misc/Games and apps/Cath Simulator/src/ui/structural/TaviLab.tsx. I applied both of the suggested fixes, but I changed the condition. The list now has a 'Valve function' heading (the existing stat-label class). The findings switch to neutral text-ink-soft while the tip context has any course event (hypotension, ST elevation, bradycardia or AV block). I did not use the suggested condition, course?.obstruction or course?.chbS. Switching the tone on the hidden obstruction would itself give the answer away, which the rule against showing ground truth on live screens forbids. Every course event is already visible on the monitor. I also used text-ink-soft instead of the suggested text-ink-dim, because tailwind.config.js has no ink-dim token.

3 (minor), tip order in heart block, in /Users/qc25212/Downloads/Misc/Games and apps/Cath Simulator/src/ui/lab/structuralTips.ts. The first suggested fix, putting the events in a different order, would do nothing. tipScore in src/content/lab/tips.ts gives +4 for any matching event regardless of position, and structural-tavi-pacing-wire-decision has no event, so it scores 3.5 against 7.5 for the coronary tip. The second suggested fix, changing the coronary tip's trigger, would mean editing src/content/manual/cath-handbook/07-tavi.ts, which is outside this package.

Instead I added a new function, attributeCourseEvents, which taviTipContext now calls. While the monitor shows unpaced complete heart block and there is no ST elevation, hypotension is not reported, because the slow rhythm on screen explains the low pressure. Once the block is paced and AV block clears, a pressure that is still low reports hypotension again and the coronary tip returns. Both inputs are visible on the monitor, so nothing hidden decides it. taviCourseEvents still returns the events unfiltered, and the acceptance test that the coronary tip appears only while MAP is below 65 after pacing still passes.

New test in /Users/qc25212/Downloads/Misc/Games and apps/Cath Simulator/src/ui/lab/structuralTips.test.ts.
